title: CSCI 320 — Principles of Data Management
subject: Data Management
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the relational database model and explain how tables, rows, columns, and declared types organize data.
Explain how primary keys, foreign keys, and constraints enforce data integrity and prevent update anomalies.
Demonstrate how normalization and indexing improve database performance and query efficiency.
